inputs.text: SSANU has given the federal government one month to complete renegotiations of the 2009 agreement, or face an indefinite nationwide strike. Workers should not have to threaten disruption to make institutions honor their commitments—but when dialogue is ignored, collective action may be the only leverage they have. Universities depend on non-teaching staff, and treating their work and livelihoods as expendable is part of a broader failure to respect labor. The government needs to negotiate seriously and deliver fair treatment, rather than leave workers to bear the cost of its inaction.
